questions.question: For what occasion is Psalm 92 titled a song?
To what is the righteous compared in Psalm 92?
options: A mighty fortress that no army can ever take
A flowing spring of water that never once runs dry
A bright morning star that shines just before the dawn
A palm tree and a cedar in Lebanon, flourishing
questions.answer: A palm tree and a cedar in Lebanon, flourishing

questions.question: The psalm says it is good to give thanks to the LORD and declare his love in the morning.
It is good to _____ the LORD and to sing praises to Your name.
The righteous flourish like the _____ tree.
